annotations.title: Count the four: does this employer need an apprentice?

description: The participation requirement (26 CFR 1.45-8(d)): a taxpayer, contractor or subcontractor that employs four or more individuals to perform construction, alteration or repair work on the facility, counted over the whole construction (not at one time), must employ at least one qualified apprentice there. Give the people one employer used on this facility with their roles; the tool says who counts toward the four (laborers, mechanics and apprentices do; a supervising foreperson, an exempt 20%+ managing owner and office staff do not; a working foreperson or superintendent over 20% manual duties who is not 541-exempt, or a nonexempt owner doing trade work, does under this server’s reading), whether an apprentice is required, and whose hours are out of the labor-hours denominator either way.

employer.description: The company (taxpayer, contractor or subcontractor) these people work for.

people.description: Everyone this employer used on the facility over the whole construction, one entry each.

does_trade_work.description: For an owner: performs covered laborer or mechanic work on the facility.

exempt_541.description: For a working foreperson or superintendent: meets the 29 CFR part 541 executive, administrative or professional exemption (salaried, primary duty management). If true the 20% test does not apply and they are not a laborer or mechanic.

manual_share.description: For a working foreperson or superintendent: the share of the workweek spent on laborer or mechanic duties (0.3 = 30%). More than 0.2, for someone not exempt under 29 CFR part 541, makes them a laborer or mechanic for that time (1.45-7(d)(8)(i)).

owner_equity_pct.description: For an owner: percent equity in the business.

owner_manages.description: For an owner: actively manages the business (29 CFR 541.101).

role.description: What the person does on this facility.
